## portfolio — read positions, fills and P&L

Does: Shows what the orders block actually achieved: position per instrument, pending entries, recent fills and account P&L.
Needs: Nothing. A visualizer sees an empty portfolio.

Calls on `IPortfolio`:
- `IReadOnlyList<PositionView> Positions { get; }` — Every open position.
- `IReadOnlyList<PendingEntryView> PendingEntries { get; }` — Every pending entry waiting for its price.
- `AccountView Account { get; }` — Equity and P&L across every instrument.
- `PositionView Position(InstrumentId instrument)` — The position in one instrument; zero units when there is none.
- `IReadOnlyList<FillView> RecentFills(int count)` — The most recent fills, oldest first.
- `IDisposable OnFill(Action<FillView> handler)` — Calls `handler` for every fill; dispose to stop.

Types:
- `PositionView(InstrumentId Instrument, double Units, double AveragePrice, double UnrealizedPnl, double RealizedPnl, double? StopPrice, double? TakeProfitPrice)` — One position.
- `PendingEntryView(InstrumentId Instrument, double Units, EntryKind Kind, double Price)` — One pending entry.
- `FillView(InstrumentId Instrument, DateTime TimeUtc, double Units, double Price, double Commission)` — One fill.
- `AccountView(double Equity, double RealizedPnl, double UnrealizedPnl, double Commission)` — The account across every instrument.

Limits: Read-only. Values reflect fills up to the last event the unit handled. P&L is net of commission and slippage.
